safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes a prescribed steroid cream but does not specify twice daily (BD) dosing as in Gold.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended twice-daily (BD) dosing for a topical steroid can lead to incorrect use (too infrequent causing persistent symptoms, or too frequent increasing risk of local adverse effects like skin thinning), potentially delaying improvement of dermatitis. While not usually life-threatening, it can meaningfully affect symptom control and follow-up needs.
